content: {"paper_id":"W2137917285","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"multi-label-learning","exact_quote":"Multi-instance multi-label learning (MIML) is a framework for supervised classification where the objects to be classified are bags of instances associated with multiple labels.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确以多实例多标记学习(MIML)为框架，对象关联多个标记，并研究实例标记预测，属多标记分类/识别任务。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"We instead consider the problem of predicting instance labels while learning from data labeled only at the bag level.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"仅使用包级标记监督，缺少实例级真值，并将其作为核心问题来学习实例预测，符合粗粒度/不完整弱监督定义。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
